# Forward-test pre-registration: the overnight blend rule (2026-10-12)

Committed before any forward market exists. The owner asked for it on 2026-10-12 ("systematically do all of these"). The only cell that held in both W4 and W5 was found after both were seen (research `w5/`, 1 of 6 hour buckets). This test decides whether it is real.

## Window

Kalshi KXBTC15M/KXETH15M markets closing in [2026-10-12T00:00Z, 2026-11-11T00:00Z), 30 days. Data comes from the daily forward pull (Kalshi markets, fees, candles, Binance klines and BVOL). The window is not extended or cut after any of it is read. If the pull misses days, the gap is reported and the window stays as written.

## Rule (frozen)

- Fair value: the W5 documents (`run-w5-blend.json`) with only the cut and panel moved forward. Same blend: logistic regression on logit(mid) and logit(fair_gru), clip 1e-4, C 1, refit every UTC day on all markets closed before that day, from 2026-08-01. Same frozen GRU (W4 refit, state_hash `541bff85…`).
- **Primary trade:** leads 9–14, decision instant 00:00 ≤ hour < 04:00 UTC. Buy YES at the ask when fair_blend − mid > fee + 0.02, or NO at 1 − bid when mid − fair_blend > fee + 0.02. One contract, taker, held to settlement.

## Primary test (the only pass/fail)

Mean P&L per contract > 0 with day-clustered t ≥ 2.0, one-sided. Expected about 15 trades a day. At the W4/W5 size (+6c) that gives t ≈ 2.3 over 30 days; it is a weak test by design and is reported as such.

## Reported, not tested

- The W5 rule (leads 8–14, all hours, 2c).
- The 1c and 3c margins.
- A retrained-GRU arm (early stop on W5), if it exists by then.
- Brier of the blend vs the market.
- A maker-quote simulation from the recorded books (`kalshi-crypto-books-15m`, 15 s), once a quote rule is written down. It is a separate pre-registration.

## After the read

A fail closes the overnight rule. A pass is followed by a second 30-day forward window before any capital is committed.

# Forward-test pre-registration: market-anchored GRU residual (2026-10-16)

This contract was written after the pre-W4 and W4/W5 development results in `docs/research/market-residual/2026-10-16-gru-market-residual-audit.md`, and before any market in this test window closes. It is separate from, and does not modify, the protected 2026-10-12 through 2026-11-11 overnight-trading test.

## Window

Kalshi KXBTC15M/KXETH15M markets closing in `[2026-10-17T00:00Z, 2027-01-15T00:00Z)`, 90 calendar days. The existing daily forward pull supplies the source data. The window is neither shortened nor extended after outcomes are read. Missing days remain missing and are reported.

The test is read once on or after 2027-01-15T00:00Z. Until then, settlement labels, score summaries, partial P&L, and model-versus-market comparisons for this window are not inspected.

## Frozen model

For each lead 2 through 14 minutes, predict YES settlement probability as:

`logit(p) = logit(mid) + a_h + b_h * z_h(logit(mid)) + c_h * z_h(logit(fair_gru) - logit(mid))`.

- The 13 sets of means, scales, and coefficients are frozen in `/home/russell/data/crypto_trading/research/market-residual/postw4-transfer-results.json`, SHA-256 `b50f20780de4cdffbddb684495bd64686ed736a698a5c5ab768110764ac649ce`.
- They were fit once on the bounded pre-W4 W1-fold12 through W2-block2 tables with L2 0.10. They are not refit in the forward window.
- `fair_gru` comes from the frozen forward GRU in `/home/russell/data/crypto_trading/production-fwd`: state hash `1353e04e77caceb9eaeb6ef1040bea5b40780a097424b34d211084421aba0201`, trained through 2026-10-06. No later GRU replaces it in this test.
- `mid` is the contemporaneous YES bid/ask midpoint at the decision instant. Probabilities are clipped to `[1e-6, 1 - 1e-6]` only for numerical log loss.
- Include exactly one valid quote row per ticker per lead. A missing quote or non-OK GRU row is excluded and counted; there is no imputation.

## Primary test

For each market, average binary log loss across its available leads 2 through 14. The primary statistic is the mean paired difference:

`hybrid market-level log loss - raw market-mid market-level log loss`.

Cluster the standard error by UTC close day. Pass only if the difference is negative and the one-sided day-clustered t statistic is at most -2.0. At least 60 active UTC days and 8,000 unique markets are required; otherwise the test is inconclusive and the window is not extended.

## Reported, not selected

- The same paired comparison against the frozen market-only slope calibration.
- Brier-score differences versus raw market and calibrated market.
- BTC and ETH splits; individual leads 2--14; four equal chronological subwindows.
- Coverage, missingness, quote age, GRU state hash, and input provenance.
- Settlement P&L at executable prices. This is diagnostic only: predictive superiority is decided before any trading rule is selected.

No subgroup, lead, margin, hour, or trading threshold can replace the primary result. A pass justifies an independently specified execution study; it does not authorize capital deployment.

## Pre-window amendment: frozen lead-hierarchy challenger (2026-10-16)

This amendment was made before the window opened and without reading any timestamp at or after the protected 2026-10-12 boundary. It does not alter the original frozen model or primary test above.

One challenger is added. It is an offset-logistic model anchored at `logit(mid)`, with a standardized correction containing market logit, GRU-minus-market logit, indicators for leads 3--14, lead-specific market-logit interactions, and lead-specific GRU-disagreement interactions. It uses L2 `0.10`, selected by bounded pre-W4 chronological replay, and was fit once on the same bounded pre-W4 tables. Its coefficients and transforms are frozen in `/home/russell/data/crypto_trading/research/market-residual/ten-more-results.json`, SHA-256 `92c13fb4d8cf5468ff100c5a34b5e061436ad25e63e750cefbfb6f09340c2507`. The generating script is `/home/russell/data/crypto_trading/research/market-residual/run_ten_more.py`, SHA-256 `2701c1c4b9c657f9bc84e7a46c8e98d0a2c48e8a041f94a9ead3721ecb7f8bb4`.

The challenger has one frozen incremental test: market-level challenger log loss minus the original hybrid's market-level log loss, using the same lead averaging, UTC-day clustering, minimum 60 active days, and minimum 8,000 markets. It passes only if the difference is negative, the one-sided day-clustered t statistic is at most `-2.0`, and its Brier difference is non-positive. This test is read at the same single 2027-01-15 endpoint. The original hybrid remains the production-free benchmark until this challenger passes; neither outcome authorizes capital deployment.
